summary: Added the five password rules to the sign-up page: they are listed under the password field as hints, and on submit each unmet rule turns red and shows its own error message. Password validation runs before the confirm-match and duplicate-email checks. All backend-side validation (if any) belongs to the separate backend repository and was left untouched.
conventions: Sign-up passwords must be at least 8 characters and contain an uppercase letter, a lowercase letter, a number and a special character (any non-alphanumeric); the rules are always visible under the password field and each unmet rule shows its own inline error on submit, before confirm-match and duplicate-email checks run

visual_check.evidence: The /signup page shows the five password rules as a bulleted list directly under the password field (at least 8 characters, one uppercase, one lowercase, one number, one special character).

context_sharing.notes: There is no HTTP API: signup persists via src/store.js helpers findUser(email)/saveUser(user) backed by localStorage key 'acme-users' (keyed by lowercased, trimmed email), with session state in sessionStorage key 'acme-current'. The stored User object omits the 'confirm' field, and src/style.css contains only presentation rules (.rules, .failed) with no contract.
